muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس اذكروا نعمت الله عليكم﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أيها: ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); الناس: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أيّ﴾; اذكروا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); نعمة الله: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); عليكم: عليكم: [Translator's note: the word is repeated thus in the source.] a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "remember His bestowing upon you", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His blessing, being upon you".
﴿هل من خالق غير الله يرزقكم من السماء والأرض﴾: هل: an interrogative particle; من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); خالق: mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form, nominative in position; غير: naʿt of ﴿خالق﴾, nominative according to the position, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the khabar (predicate) of خالق is omitted, its implied form being "لكم"; the clause ﴿يرزقكم﴾ is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of ﴿خالق﴾ according to the position, or in the position of genitive according to the form, or resumptive with no grammatical position, or in the position of nominative as the khabar of ﴿خالق﴾; من السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرزقكم﴾; الأرض: conjoined to السماء.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: badal (substitute) from the position of lā and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun latent (mustakinn) in the omitted khabar; and the clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فأنى تؤفكون﴾: الفاء: resumptive; أنى: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; تؤفكون: a passive imperfect verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw of the plural is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿فأنى تؤفكون﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وإن يكذبوك فقد كذبت رسل من قبلك﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; إن: a jussive conditional particle; يكذبوك: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). الفاء: linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); كذبت: a passive past verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); رسل: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); من قبلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسل; and the clause ﴿قد كذبت ...﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وإلى الله ترجع الأمور﴾: الواو: conjunctive; إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترجع﴾; ترجع: a passive imperfect verb; الأمور: nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس إن وعد الله حق﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أيها: ﴿أيُّ﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); الناس: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أيّ﴾; إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); وعد: the noun of inna, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); حق: the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿فلا تغرنكم الحياة الدنيا ولا يغرنكم بالله الغرور﴾: الفاء: the fāʾ of faṣīḥa, disclosing something implied, i.e. "if you know that, then let it not deceive you". لا: prohibitive; تغرنكم: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الحياة: fāʿil (agent); الدنيا: naʿt; ولا يغرنكم: conjoined to ﴿لا تغرنكم﴾; بالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغرنكم﴾; الغرور: the fāʿil of يغرنكم.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿إن الشيطان لكم عدو فاتخذوه عدوا﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الشيطان: the noun of inna; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عدو﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it; عدو: the khabar (predicate) of inna; الفاء: the fāʾ of faṣīḥa, disclosing something implied, i.e. "if you know that, then take him". اتخذوه: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عدوًّا: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إنما يدعو حزبه ليكونوا من أصحاب السعير﴾: إنما: restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يدعو: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "هو"; حزبه: mafʿūl bihi, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ليكونوا: the lām is for cause (taʿlīl) or for consequence (ʿāqiba); يكونوا: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive is attached to ﴿يدعو﴾; the wāw of the plural is the noun of yakūnu; من أصحاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of yakūnu; السعير: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿الذين كفروا لهم عذاب شديد﴾: الذين: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); كفروا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿عذاب﴾; عذاب: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause ﴿لهم عذاب﴾ is the khabar of الذين; شديد: naʿt (adjective). It has also been said: the relative noun is a badal (substitute) from the wāw in ﴿ليكونوا﴾, or in the position of accusative as a badal from ﴿حزبَه﴾ or a naʿt of it, or in the position of genitive as a naʿt of, or badal from, ﴿أصحاب﴾.
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم مغفرة وأجر كبير﴾: الواو: conjunctive; الذين: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; آمنوا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. عملوا: a verb and its fāʿil; الصالحات: the object of عملوا; the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of ﴿مغفرة﴾; مغفرة: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لهم مغفرة﴾ is the khabar of الذين; أجر: conjoined to مغفرة; كبير: naʿt.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿أفمن زين له سوء عمله فرآه حسنا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza: for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); الفاء: resumptive; من: a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, indicated by the context of the speech, its implied form being "كمن هداه الله" (like one whom Allah has guided), or "كمن لم يُزَيَّن له" (like one to whom it has not been made to seem fair). زين: a passive past verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زين﴾; سوء: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); عمله: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿زين﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. فرآه: ﴿الفاء﴾ is conjunctive, and ﴿رآه﴾ is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), implied as "هو", and ﴿الهاء﴾ is the first object of رأى; حسنًا: the second object of رأى, because it is a verb of the heart (qalbiyya); the clause ﴿رآه﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿زُيِّن﴾. It has also been said: ﴿مَن﴾ here is a conditional noun, and زين is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "ذهبت نفسك عليهم حسرات" (your soul would go out in regrets over them).
﴿فإن الله يضل من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء﴾: الفاء: resumptive; إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; the clause ﴿يضل﴾ is the khabar of inna; مَن: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the object of يضل; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. الواو: conjunctive; and the clause ﴿فإن الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: this remark on the clause ﴿فإن الله...﴾ stands at this point in the source, between the wāw and the word it introduces.] يهدي: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "هو"; مَن: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the object of يهدي; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يهدي من يشاء﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يضل من يشاء﴾.
﴿فلا تذهب نفسك عليهم حسرات﴾: الفاء: the fāʾ of faṣīḥa, disclosing something implied, i.e. "if the matter is so, then let not your soul go out ... etc."; لا: prohibitive; تذهب: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; نفسك: fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; عليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تذهب﴾ or to ﴿حسرات﴾; حسرات: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of regrets", or a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "yearning", or as though it had all become regrets through the excess of grieving.
﴿إن الله عليم بما يصنعون﴾: إن: an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; عليم: the khabar of inna; بما: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative in the position of genitive, or maṣdariyya, forming with what follows an interpreted maṣdar genitive by the bāʾ; the bāʾ with its genitive is attached to ﴿عليم﴾; يصنعون: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿يصنعون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿إن الله عليم بما يصنعون﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿والله الذي أرسل الرياح فتثير سحابا﴾: الواو: resumptive; الله: mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي: a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); أرسل: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "هو", referring to Allah, Mighty and Majestic; الرياح: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أرسل الرياح﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿والله الذي...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; الفاء: conjunctive; تثير: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "هي", referring to the winds; سحابًا: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تثير سحابا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أرسل الرياح﴾.
﴿فسقناه إلى بلد ميت فأحيينا به الأرض بعد موتها﴾: فسقناه: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and ﴿سقناه﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ the fāʿil and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿سقناه﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تثير سحابا﴾ by way of iltifāt (a shift of person); إلى بلد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سقناه﴾; ميت: naʿt (adjective); الفاء: conjunctive; أحيينا: a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ the fāʿil; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحيينا﴾; الأرض: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿فأحيينا به الأرض﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿سقناه﴾; بعد: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿أحيينا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الأرض.
﴿كذلك النشور﴾: كذلك: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; النشور: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿من كان يريد العزة فلله العزة جميعا﴾: من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun latent (mustatir), referring to ﴿مَن﴾; يريد: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent; العزة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of kāna; الفاء: causal, for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar; العزة: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "فليطلبها من الله" (let him seek it from Allah), and the clause ﴿فلله العزة﴾ gives the reason for the implied apodosis; جميعًا: ḥāl (circumstantial); the conditional clause and its apodosis are the khabar of the conditional ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿إليه يصعد الكلم الطيب والعمل الصالح يرفعه﴾: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī); إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يصعد﴾; يصعد: an imperfect verb; الكلم: fāʿil; الطيب: naʿt (adjective) of الكلم; الواو: conjunctive; the clause ﴿إليه يصعد...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; العمل: mubtadaʾ; الصالح: naʿt; يرفعه: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun implied as "هو", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يرفعه﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿والعمل الصالح يرفعه﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إليه يصعد ...﴾. Or ﴿العمل الصالح﴾ is conjoined to ﴿الكلم الطيب﴾, so that it too ascends, and on this view the clause ﴿يرفعه﴾ is a resumption with no grammatical position; it is a statement from Allah the Exalted that He raises them both.
﴿والذين يمكرون السيئات لهم عذاب شديد﴾: الواو: conjunctive; الذين: a relative noun in the position of mubtadaʾ; يمكرون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; السيئات: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "they plot the evil plots", or mafʿūl bihi on the view that ﴿يمكرون﴾ is made to carry the meaning of "they do" or "they earn"; the clause ﴿يمكرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿والذين يمكرون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من كان يريد العزة﴾. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ﴿لهم عذاب شديد﴾ in this entry.]
﴿ومكر أولئك هو يبور﴾: الواو: resumptive; مكر: mubtadaʾ; أولئك: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); هو: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يبور﴾ is the khabar of مكر. Or the pronoun ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, the clause ﴿يبور﴾ is the khabar of هو, and the nominal clause ﴿هو يبور﴾ is the khabar of مكر; and the clause ﴿ومكر أولئك هو يبور﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿والله خلقكم من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم جعلكم أزواجا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿خلقكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); من تراب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقكم﴾; ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; من نطفة: conjoined to ﴿من تراب﴾; ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; جعلكم: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "هو", the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural; أزواجًا: the second object of جعل; the clause ﴿جعلكم أزواجا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خلقكم من تراب﴾.
﴿وما تحمل من أنثى ولا تضع إلا بعلمه﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ما: negating; تحمل: an imperfect verb in the nominative; من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); أنثى: genitive by من in form, nominative in position as the fāʿil; ولا تضع: conjoined to ﴿ما تحمل﴾; إلا: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); بعلمه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "except that her carrying and her delivering are known".
﴿وما يعمر من معمر ولا ينقص من عمره إلا في كتاب﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ما: negating; يعمر: a passive imperfect verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); من: a redundant preposition; معمر: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ولا ينقص: conjoined to ﴿ما يعمر﴾; ينقص: a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil latent, implied as "هو"; من عمره: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينقص﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا: a particle of restriction; في كتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "except written in a Book".
﴿إن ذلك على الله يسير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ذلك: the noun of inna; على الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسير﴾; يسير: the khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وما يستوي البحران هذا عذب فرات سائغ شرابه وهذا ملح أجاج﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ما: negating; يستوي: an imperfect verb in the nominative; البحران: fāʿil (agent) in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the alif because it is dual; هذا: mubtadaʾ (subject); عذب: khabar (predicate); فرات: a second khabar, or a naʿt (adjective) of عذب; سائغ: a third khabar or a second naʿt; شرابه: the fāʿil of ﴿سائغ﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). Or ﴿سائغ﴾ is a fronted khabar and شرابه a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿سائغ شرابه﴾ is a third khabar or a naʿt; the clause ﴿هذا عذب ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿البحران﴾; هذا: mubtadaʾ; ملح: khabar; أجاج: a second khabar or a naʿt; the clause ﴿هذا ملح أجاج﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿هذا عذب فرات﴾.
﴿ومن كل تأكلون لحما طريا وتستخرجون حلية تلبسونها﴾: الواو: conjunctive, or resumptive; من كل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تأكلون﴾; تأكلون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; لحمًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); طريًّا: naʿt; the clause ﴿ومن كل تأكلون...﴾ is conjoined, serving as a completion and supplement to the comparison, or is a digressive resumption with no grammatical position; تستخرجون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; حلية: mafʿūl bihi; تلبسونها: an imperfect verb, the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تلبسونها﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿حلية﴾, and the clause ﴿تستخرجون حلية تلبسونها﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تأكلون لحما طريا﴾.
﴿وترى الفلك فيه مواخر لتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ترى: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "أنت"; الفلك: mafʿūl bihi; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مواخر﴾ or to ﴿ترى﴾; مواخر: ḥāl; لتبتغوا: the lām is for cause (taʿlīl), and ﴿تبتغوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of cause; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām of cause with its genitive is attached to ﴿مواخر﴾; من فضله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبتغوا﴾; ﴿ولعلكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is the noun of laʿalla and the mīm is for the plural; تشكرون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿تشكرون﴾ is the khabar of laʿalla, and the clause ﴿لعلكم تشكرون﴾ is conjoined to the genitive interpreted maṣdar, i.e. "for seeking, and that you may be grateful".

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿يولج الليل في النهار ويولج النهار في الليل﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; يولج: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "هو", referring to Allah the Exalted; الليل: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يولج﴾; في النهار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يولج﴾; ويولج النهار في الليل: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وسخر الشمس والقمر كل يجري لأجل مسمى﴾: الواو: conjunctive; سخر: a verb and a latent fāʿil referring to Allah; الشمس: mafʿūl bihi; القمر: conjoined to الشمس; كل: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يجري﴾ is the khabar (predicate); لأجل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجري﴾; مسمى: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجل﴾.
﴿ذلكم الله ربكم له الملك﴾: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī); ذلكم: mubtadaʾ; الله: first khabar of ﴿ذلكم﴾; ربكم: second khabar, or a naʿt of الله; the clause ﴿ذلكم الله ربكم﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. له: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of ﴿الملك﴾; الملك: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿له الملك﴾ is a third khabar of ﴿ذلكم﴾.
﴿والذين تدعون من دونه ما يملكون من قطمير﴾: الواو: circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or resumptive, or conjoining to the clause ﴿ذلكم الله ...﴾; الذين: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; تدعون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is the implied object of تدعون, i.e. "and those whom you call upon (تدعونهم)"; من دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied object of تدعون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ما: negating; يملكون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); قطمير: genitive in form, accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يملكون﴾; the clause ﴿ما يملكون﴾ is the khabar of الذين, and the clause ﴿والذين تدعون...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿إن تدعوهم لا يسمعوا دعاءكم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; إن: a jussive conditional particle; تدعوهم: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is the sign of the plural; لا: negating; يسمعوا: an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; دعاءكم: mafʿūl bihi, and the pronoun of the addressee is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); His words ﴿لا يسمعوا﴾ are the apodosis.
﴿ولو سمعوا ما استجابوا لكم﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لو: a conditional particle; سمعوا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ما: negating; استجابوا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-ḥāzim condition [Translator's note: the source reads «غير حازم»; «غير جازم» (non-jussive) is evidently intended.], and the clause ﴿ولو سمعوا ...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن تدعوهم ...﴾.
﴿ويوم القيامة يكفرون بشرككم﴾: الواو: conjunctive; يوم: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكفرون﴾; يكفرون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; بشرككم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكفرون﴾, and the pronoun of the addressee is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن تدعوهم ...﴾.
﴿ولا ينبئك مثل خبير﴾: الواو: resumptive; لا: negating; ينبئك: an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; مثل: the fāʿil of ينبئك; خبير: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿ولا ينبئك مثل خبير﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس أنتم الفقراء إلى الله﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. يا: a vocative particle; ﴿أيّ﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); ﴿الناس﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; أنتم: mubtadaʾ (subject); الفقراء: khabar (predicate); إلى الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿الفقراء﴾.
﴿والله هو الغني الحميد﴾: الواو: conjunctive; الله: mubtadaʾ; هو: a second mubtadaʾ; ﴿الغني الحميد﴾ are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the nominal clause ﴿هو الغني الحميد﴾ is the khabar of the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿الغني الحميد﴾ are two khabars of the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾; the clause ﴿الله هو الغني الحميد﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أنتم الفقراء ...﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿إن يشأ يذهبكم ويأت بخلق جديد﴾: إن: a jussive conditional particle; يشأ: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with sukūn; يذهبكم: an imperfect verb, jussive with sukūn, and it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); يأتِ: an imperfect verb, jussive by conjunction with ﴿يذهبْكم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; بخلق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتِ﴾; جديد: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿خلق﴾, genitive; the whole conditional sentence is resumptive within the scope of the vocative, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿وما ذلك على الله بعزيز﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ما: the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ذلك: the noun of ﴿ما﴾; على الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عزيز﴾; الباء: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); عزيز: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; the clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional sentence.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لا: negating; تزر: an imperfect verb; ﴿وازرة﴾: fāʿil (agent), or naʿt (adjective) of an omitted fāʿil, i.e. "no burdened soul (نفسٌ وازرة) bears"; ﴿وزر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أخرى: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإن تدع مثقلة إلى حملها لا يحمل منه شيء ولو كان ذا قربى﴾: الواو: conjunctive; إن: a jussive conditional particle; تدعُ: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; مثقلة: naʿt of an omitted fāʿil, i.e. "a soul weighed down with sins"; إلى حملها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدع﴾, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; the mafʿūl bihi is omitted; لا: negating; يحمل: a passive imperfect verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu) in the jussive; منه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿شيء﴾, because it was originally a naʿt of it and was placed before it; شيء: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿لا يحمل﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لو is conditional; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the noun of kāna latent (mustatir), the implied form being "وإن كان المدعو ذا قربى" (even if the one called upon is a relative); ذا: the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative with alif; قربى: muḍāf ilayhi; the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, indicated by what precedes; the clause ﴿ولو كان ذا قربى﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿إنما تنذر الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب وأقاموا الصلاة﴾: إنما: restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); تنذر: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "أنت"; الذين: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تنذر﴾. The clause ﴿يخشون ربهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. يخشون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ربهم: the object of ﴿يخشون﴾, the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural; بالغيب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of يخشون, i.e. "they fear their Lord while absent from people's eyes in their private moments, or while absent from His punishment", or attached to an omitted ḥāl from the object of يخشون, i.e. "they fear His punishment while it is hidden from them, not witnessed by them". أقاموا: a past verb and its fāʿil; الصلاة: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أقاموا الصلاة﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يخشون ربهم﴾.
﴿ومن تزكى فإنما يتزكى لنفسه﴾: الواو: resumptive; من: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تزكى: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; الفاء: linking the apodosis; إنما: restraining and restrained; يتزكى: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "هو"; لنفسه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتزكى﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿ومن تزكى...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وإلى الله المصير﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ﴿وإلى الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; المصير: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿إلى الله المصير﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause ﴿من تزكى...﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وما يستوي الأعمى والبصير﴾: الواو: resumptive; ما: negating; يستوي: an imperfect verb; الأعمى: fāʿil (agent); الواو: conjunctive; البصير: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الأعمى; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ولا الظلمات﴾: الواو: conjunctive, conjoining a clause to a clause; لا: ṣila (redundant), to reinforce the negation; الظلمات: fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "تستوي".
﴿ولا النور﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لا: ṣila, to reinforce the negation; النور: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الظلمات, nominative; the clause is conjoined to the one before it, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿ولا الظل﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لا: ṣila (redundant), to reinforce the negation; الظل: fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "يستوي".
﴿ولا الحرور﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لا: ṣila, to reinforce the negation; الحرور: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الظل, nominative; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿ما يستوي الأعمى والبصير﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وما يستوي الأحياء ولا الأموات﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ما: negating; يستوي: an imperfect verb; الأحياء: fāʿil (agent); الواو: conjunctive; لا: ṣila (redundant), to reinforce the negation; الأموات: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الأحياء; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿ما يستوي الأعمى والبصير﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله يسمع من يشاء﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; the clause ﴿يسمع﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna; يسمع: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "هو", referring to Allah, Mighty and Majestic; من: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما أنت بمسمع من في القبور﴾: الواو: conjunctive; ما: the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; أنت: the noun of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿بمسمع﴾: الباء: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila), and مسمع: the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; مَن: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ﴿مسمع﴾; في القبور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ما أنت بمسمع من في القبور﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن الله يُسمع من يشاء﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿إن أنت إلا نذير﴾: إن: negating; أنت: mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); نذير: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿أنت﴾; the clause is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿إنا أرسلناك بالحق بشيرا ونذيرا﴾: إنّا: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿أرسلناك﴾ is its khabar (predicate); أرسلناك: a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلناك﴾, or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "being in the right (مُحِقِّين)", or from the object, i.e. "being in the right (مُحِقًّا)", or attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "a sending accompanied by the truth". بشيرًا: ḥāl from the object of أرسلناك; نذيرًا: conjoined to ﴿بشيرا﴾; the clause ﴿إنا أرسلناك ...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن من أمة إلا خلا فيها نذير﴾: الواو: conjunctive; إن: negating; من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); أمة: genitive in form, nominative in position as mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); خلا: a past verb; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلا﴾; نذير: fāʿil; the clause ﴿خلا فيها نذير﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿إن من أمة ...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إنا أرسلناك ...﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وإن يكذبوك فقد كذب الذين من قبلهم﴾: الواو: conjunctive; إن: a jussive conditional particle; يكذبوك: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فقد: ﴿الفاء﴾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); كذب: a past verb; الذين: a relative noun, fāʿil; من قبلهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The attached pronoun of the absent plural is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿فقد كذب...﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, or it stands in place of the apodosis and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "فاصبر" (so be patient) or "فلا يحزنك تكذيبهم" (so let not their denial grieve you).
﴿جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات وبالزبر وبالكتاب المنير﴾: جاءتهم: a past verb; the tāʾ is a particle of the feminine with no grammatical position, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; رسلهم: fāʿil in the nominative, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; بالبينات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءتهم﴾; بالزبر: conjoined to ﴿بالبينات﴾; بالكتاب: also conjoined to ﴿بالبينات﴾; المنير: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كتاب﴾; the clause ﴿جاءتهم رسلهم﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿ثم أخذت الذين كفروا فكيف كان نكير﴾: ثم: a conjunction; أخذت: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); الذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كفروا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿أخذت الذين كفروا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿فقد كذب﴾, in the position of jussive; الفاء: conjunctive; كيف: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb; نكير: the noun of kāna, nominative with a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the omitted yāʾ, and the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿كيف كان نكير﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أخذت الذين كفروا﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله أنزل من السماء ماء﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza: for interrogation seeking affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); لم: a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; ترَ: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "أنت"; أنّ: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is the noun of anna; أنزل: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "هو"; ماء: the object of أنزل; the clause ﴿أنزل من السماء ماء﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and anna with what is in its scope stands in place of the two objects of ﴿ترَ﴾. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ﴿من السماء﴾ here.]
﴿فأخرجنا به ثمرات مختلفا ألوانها﴾: الفاء: conjunctive; أخرجنا: a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿أخرجنا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أنزل﴾; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرجنا﴾; ثمرات: the object of أخرجنا; مختلفًا: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ثمرات﴾, and it is a causal adjective (naʿt sababī); ألوانها: fāʿil of the active participle ﴿مختلفا﴾.
﴿ومن الجبال جدد بيض وحمر مختلف ألوانها وغرابيب سود﴾: الواو: conjunctive; من الجبال: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; جدد: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); بيض: naʿt of ﴿جدد﴾; حمر: conjoined to ﴿بيض﴾; مختلف: also a naʿt of ﴿جدد﴾; ألوانها: fāʿil of the active participle ﴿مختلف﴾; غرابيب: conjoined to ﴿جدد﴾ or to ﴿بيض﴾; سود: badal (substitute) from غرابيب; the clause ﴿ومن الجبال جدد﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause ﴿ألم تر ...﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ومن الناس والدواب والأنعام مختلف ألوانه كذلك﴾: الواو: conjunctive; من الناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿الدواب والأنعام﴾: both conjoined to الناس; مختلف ألوانه: naʿt (adjective) of something omitted, which is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "a kind whose colours differ (صنفٌ مختلفٌ ألوانُه)"; ألوانه: fāʿil (agent) of the active participle ﴿مختلف﴾; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e. "differing in colour with a difference like that difference"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; the clause ﴿ومن الناس...﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause ﴿ألم تر ...﴾.
﴿إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلماء﴾: إنما: restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يخشى: an imperfect verb; الله: the object of يخشى, fronted; من عباده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the delayed fāʿil ﴿العلماء﴾; العلماء: fāʿil, nominative with ḍamma; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله عزيز غفور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; عزيز: the khabar of inna; غفور: a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿إن الذين يتلون كتاب الله﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; يتلون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); كتابَ الله: the object of يتلون, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يتلون كتاب الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأقاموا الصلاة﴾: أقاموا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; الصلاة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أقاموا الصلاة﴾ is conjoined to the ṣila clause, falling within its scope.
﴿وأنفقوا مما رزقناهم سرا وعلانية﴾: الواو: conjunctive; أنفقوا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; مما: ﴿من﴾ is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive, or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, forming with the verb ﴿رزقناهم﴾ an interpreted maṣdar in the genitive, i.e. "from Our providing them", in the sense of what is provided, because one does not spend from the act of providing; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنفقوا﴾; the clause ﴿رزقناهم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. سرًّا: a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿أنفقوا﴾; علانية: conjoined to ﴿سرّا﴾, i.e. "doing it secretly and openly".
﴿يرجون تجارة لن تبور﴾: يرجون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; تجارة: mafʿūl bihi; لن: a particle of negation, of the subjunctive and of the future; تبور: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan; the clause ﴿لن تبور﴾ is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿تجارة﴾, and the clause ﴿يرجون تجارة...﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. It has also been said: the clause ﴿يرجون تجارة ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, and the khabar of ﴿إن﴾ is the clause ﴿إنه غفور شكور﴾ in the following ayah; and the clause ﴿إن الذين يتلون...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿ليوفيهم أجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله﴾: ليوفيهم: the lām is for consequence and outcome (al-ʿāqiba wa-l-ṣayrūra) or for cause (taʿlīl), and ﴿يوفيهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb ﴿يوفيهم﴾ is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرجون﴾ or to ﴿لن تبور﴾, or attached to something omitted that the context indicates, the lām then being for cause only, i.e. "they did that so that He might pay them in full"; the hāʾ in ﴿ليوفيهم﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; أجورهم: second mafʿūl bihi, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); يزيدهم: conjoined to ﴿يوفيهم﴾; من فضله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يزيدهم﴾, and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of genitive by annexation.
﴿إنه غفور شكور﴾: إنه: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the hāʾ is its noun; غفور: first khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾; شكور: second khabar of ﴿إن﴾; the clause ﴿إنه غفور شكور﴾ gives the reason for what precedes. It has also been said: the clause ﴿يرجون﴾ in the previous ayah is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the khabar of ﴿إن﴾ is His words ﴿إنه غفور شكور﴾.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿والذي أوحينا إليك من الكتاب هو الحق مصدقا لما بين يديه﴾: الواو: resumptive; الذي: a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); أوحينا: a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أوحينا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; it is the implied object of ﴿أوحينا﴾, i.e. ﴿والذي أوحيناه﴾; إليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾; من الكتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied object of أوحينا; هو: mubtadaʾ; الحق: khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause ﴿هو الحق﴾ is the khabar of الذي; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and ﴿الحق﴾ is the khabar of الذي; مصدقًا: an emphasising ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida); لما: the lām is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾; بين: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. يديه: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the attached pronoun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إن الله بعباده لخبير بصير﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الله: the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna; بعباده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبير بصير﴾, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); خبير: first khabar of ﴿إن﴾; بصير: second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ثم أورثنا الكتاب الذين اصطفينا من عبادنا﴾: ثم: a conjunction for sequence with delay; أورثنا: a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); الكتاب: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أورثنا﴾; الذين: first mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أورثنا﴾; اصطفينا: a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿اصطفينا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; it is the object of اصطفينا, i.e. "those whom We chose (اصطفيناهم)"; من عبادنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) [from] the implied object of اصطفينا.
﴿فمنهم ظالم لنفسه ومنهم مقتصد ومنهم سابق بالخيرات بإذن الله﴾: الفاء: for subdivision (tafrīʿiyya); منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ظالم﴾; ظالم: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); لنفسه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظالم﴾; منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of ﴿مقتصد﴾; مقتصد: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿منهم مقتصد﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿منهم ظالم لنفسه﴾; منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of ﴿سابق﴾; سابق: a delayed mubtadaʾ; بالخيرات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سابق﴾; the clause ﴿منهم سابق﴾ is also conjoined to the clause ﴿منهم ظالم لنفسه﴾; بإذن الله: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿سابق بالخيرات﴾, or attached to ﴿سابق﴾, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ذلك هو الفضل الكبير﴾: ذلك: mubtadaʾ; هو: a second mubtadaʾ; الفضل: khabar of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause ﴿هو الفضل﴾ is the khabar of ذلك; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and ﴿الفضل﴾ is the khabar of ذلك; الكبير: naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿جنات عدن يدخلونها﴾: جنات: badal (substitute) from ﴿الفضل﴾, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is gardens", or a second khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾, or a mubtadaʾ; عدن: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); يدخلونها: an imperfect verb, the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent) and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يدخلونها﴾ is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of جنات, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿جنات﴾, or in the position of nominative as khabar if we parse جنات as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا﴾: the clause is a ḥāl from the fāʿil in ﴿يدخلونها﴾, or a second khabar of ﴿جنات﴾ if we parse جنات as a mubtadaʾ; يحلون: a passive imperfect verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from the nāʾib fāʿil; من أساور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted second object, i.e. "they are adorned therein with ornaments arising from bracelets that are of gold"; من ذهب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿أساور﴾; لؤلؤا: conjoined to the omitted object, or accusative by an omitted verb, i.e. "and they are given pearls (ويُؤتَون لؤلؤًا)".
﴿ولباسهم فيها حرير﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لباسهم: mubtadaʾ, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; حرير: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وقالوا الحمد لله الذي أذهب عنا الحزن﴾: الواو: conjunctive; قالوا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject); لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); الذي: a relative noun in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty; أذهب: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "هو"; الحزن: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أذهب﴾; the clause ﴿أذهب عنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. عنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أذهب﴾; the clause ﴿الحمد لله ...﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative.
﴿إن ربنا لغفور شكور﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربنا: the noun of inna; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غفور: first khabar of ﴿إن﴾; شكور: second khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿الذي أحلنا دار المقامة من فضله﴾: الذي: a relative noun in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) from ﴿الذي﴾ in the previous ayah; the clause ﴿أحلنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. أحلنا: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and ﴿نا﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); دار: second mafʿūl bihi; المقامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من فضله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أحلنا﴾.
﴿لا يمسنا فيها نصب ولا يمسنا فيها لغوب﴾: لا: negating; يمسنا: an imperfect verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمسنا﴾; نصب: fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يمسنا﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first object of ﴿أحلنا﴾ or from the second object; الواو: conjunctive; the clause ﴿لا يمسنا فيها لغوب﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لا يمسنا فيها نصب﴾; لغوب: fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿والذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم﴾: الذين: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); نار: a delayed mubtadaʾ; جهنم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause ﴿لهم نار جهنم﴾ is the khabar of الذين.
﴿لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا﴾: the clause is a second khabar of ﴿الذين﴾ or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from them; لا: negating; يقضى: a passive imperfect verb (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "هو"; عليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقضى﴾; الفاء: causative (sababiyya); يموتوا: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the causative fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb ﴿يموتوا﴾ is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "there is no decree, and so no death".
﴿ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها﴾: الواو: conjunctive; يخفف: a passive imperfect verb; عنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخفف﴾; من عذابها: a preposition and its genitive noun standing in place of the agent, or ﴿من﴾ is a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila) and ﴿عذابها﴾ is nāʾib fāʿil, nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿من﴾; the clause ﴿لا يخفف...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا يقضى...﴾.
﴿كذلك نجزي كل كفور﴾: كذلك: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e. "We recompense them with a recompense like that recompense"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; نجزي: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent, implied as "نحن"; كل: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كفور: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وهم﴾: الواو: conjunctive; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يصطرخون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصطرخون﴾; the clause ﴿يصطرخون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.
﴿ربنا﴾: ﴿رب﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative, with the vocative particle omitted, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أخرجنا﴾: a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "أنت", and ﴿نا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿نعمل﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), its fāʿil latent, implied as "نحن"; ﴿صالحا﴾: mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نعمل﴾, or standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "he did a righteous deed (عمل عملًا صالحًا)".
﴿غير﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿صالحا﴾.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿كنّا﴾: the defective (nāqiṣa) ﴿كان﴾, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿نعمل﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause ﴿نعمل﴾ is the khabar of kāna, and the clause ﴿كنا نعمل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The vocative clause ﴿ربنا أخرجنا...﴾ is the speech of an implied verb of saying, in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "saying: Our Lord ... etc.".
﴿أولم نعمركم ما يتذكر فيه من تذكر وجاءكم النذير﴾: the clause is the speech of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "and it will be said to them: did We not give you life long enough…"; the hamza: for interrogation, and it is an interrogation of rebuke, of bringing to a halt, and of seeking affirmation; الواو: conjoining to something implied, i.e. "did We not grant you respite and defer you for a lifetime in which whoever would remember could remember?"; لم: a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; نعمركم: an imperfect verb, jussive by lam, its fāʿil latent, implied as "نحن", the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; ما: an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda) [Translator's note: so in the source; since its clause is then called a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾, «نكرة موصوفة» (a qualified indefinite) may be intended.] in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, i.e. "a time", or in the position of accusative as a maṣdar, i.e. "a granting of life"; يتذكر: an imperfect verb; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتذكر﴾; من: a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause ﴿تذكر﴾ is the ṣila of مَن, and the clause ﴿يتذكر فيه من تذكر﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾; الواو: conjunctive; جاءكم: a past verb, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; النذير: fāʿil; the clause ﴿جاءكم النذير﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أولم نعمركم﴾, i.e. "We did give you life, and the warner came to you".
﴿فذوقوا فما للظالمين من نصير﴾: فذوقوا: the fāʾ is of faṣīḥa, to make the command to taste follow upon what precedes it of the granting of life and the coming of the warner; ذوقوا: an imperative verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ in ﴿فما﴾ is causal (taʿlīl), and ما is negating; للظالمين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); نصير: a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿إن الله عالم غيب السماوات والأرض﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; عالم: the khabar (predicate) of inna; غيب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and غيب is itself muḍāf; السماوات: muḍāf ilayhi; الأرض: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿إنه عليم بذات الصدور﴾: إنه: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; عليم: the khabar of inna; بذات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عليم﴾; الصدور: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿هو الذي جعلكم خلائف في الأرض﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; هو: mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي: a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; جعلكم: a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); خلائف: second mafʿūl bihi; في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلائف﴾ or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿خلائف﴾; the clause ﴿جعلكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن كفر فعليه كفره﴾: الفاء: resumptive; من: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; كفر: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); الفاء: linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; كفره: a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause ﴿عليه كفره﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the clause ﴿فمن كفر...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يزيد الكافرين كفرهم عند ربهم إلا مقتا﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لا: negating; يزيد: an imperfect verb; الكافرين: a fronted mafʿūl bihi; كفرهم: a delayed fāʿil; عند: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ربهم: ﴿رب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إلا: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); مقتًا: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يزيد﴾; the clause is conjoined to the one before it.
﴿ولا يزيد الكافرين كفرهم إلا خسارا﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لا: negating; يزيد: an imperfect verb; الكافرين: a fronted mafʿūl bihi; كفرهم: a delayed fāʿil; إلا: a particle of restriction; خسارا: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يزيد﴾; the clause is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم شركاءكم الذين تدعون من دون الله﴾: قل: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "أنت"; ﴿أرأيتم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and رأيتم is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿أرأيتم﴾ has been made to carry the meaning of "inform me", and on this basis it takes two objects; شركاءكم: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرأيتم﴾; الذين: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective); تدعون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; it is the object of تدعون, i.e. "those whom you call upon (تدعونهم)". ﴿من دون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied object of تدعون; the Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أروني﴾: an imperative verb; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the speaker is mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿أروني﴾ is parenthetical with no grammatical position, coming as a parenthesis between the verb ﴿رأيتم﴾ and its second object, the clause ﴿ماذا خلقوا...﴾; or the clause ﴿أروني ماذا خلقوا من الأرض﴾ is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from أرأيتم, as though it were said: "Inform me about your partners: show me what thing they have created of the earth?".
﴿ماذا خلقوا من الأرض﴾: ماذا: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿خلق﴾; خلقوا: a verb and its fāʿil; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾, and the clause ﴿خلقوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun is omitted; it is the object of خلق, i.e. "what is it that they created (خلقوه)". من الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلقوا﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl from the object of خلق; the clause ﴿ماذا خلقوا...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أرأيتم﴾ if the clause ﴿أروني﴾ is parenthetical; or the clause ﴿ماذا خلقوا...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أروني﴾, the matter being a case of contention between governors (tanāzuʿ), in which the second verb has been made to govern.
﴿أم لهم شرك في السماوات﴾: أم: a conjunction, and it is the disjoined (munqaṭiʿa) am, in the sense of "nay" together with the hamza of disapproving interrogation, i.e. "nay, do they have a share in the heavens?". ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; شرك: a delayed mubtadaʾ; في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of ﴿شرك﴾.
﴿أم آتيناهم كتابا فهم على بينة منه﴾: conjoined to what precedes; آتيناهم: a verb, its fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; كتابًا: second mafʿūl bihi; الفاء: a conjunction; هم: mubtadaʾ; على بينة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; منه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿بينة﴾.
﴿بل إن يعد الظالمون بعضهم بعضا إلا غرورا﴾: بل: a particle of transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī); إن: negating; يعد: an imperfect verb; الظالمون: fāʿil; بعضهم: badal (substitute) from ﴿الظالمون﴾, a badal of part for whole; بعضًا: the object of ﴿يعد﴾; إلا: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); غرورًا: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يعد﴾, or a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. "except a promise of delusion".

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿إن الله يمسك السماوات والأرض أن تزولا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الله: the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna; يمسك: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "هو"; السماوات: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأرض: conjoined to السماوات; the clause ﴿يمسك السماوات والأرض﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna; أن: maṣdariyya, governing the subjunctive; تزولا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the alif of the dual is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تزولا﴾ is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with an omitted muḍāf understood, i.e. "out of aversion to their ceasing"; or ﴿يمسك﴾ has been made to carry the meaning of "prevents", so the interpreted maṣdar is a second mafʿūl bihi; or it is by removal of the preposition, i.e. "He prevents them from ceasing (من أن تزولا)", the preposition and its genitive ﴿من أن تزولا﴾ being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يمسك﴾; or it is accusative as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from السماوات والأرض, i.e. "He prevents their ceasing".
﴿ولئن زالتا إن أمسكهما من أحد من بعده﴾: الواو: conjunctive; the lām: preparing for an oath (mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن: conditional; زالتا: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); إن: negating; أمسكهما: a past verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm and alif are the sign of the dual; من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); أحد: fāʿil of ﴿أمسكهما﴾, genitive in form by ﴿من﴾, nominative in position; من بعده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أحد﴾; the clause ﴿إن أمسكهما...﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an implied oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath; the clause ﴿لئن زالتا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿إن الله يمسك السماوات...﴾.
﴿إنه كان حليما غفورا﴾: إنه: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the noun of kāna latent, implied as "هو"; حليما: the khabar of kāna; غفورا: a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; the clause ﴿كان حليما غفورا﴾ is the khabar of inna, and the clause ﴿إنه كان...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم لئن جاءهم نذير ليكونن أهدى من إحدى الأمم﴾: الواو: resumptive; ﴿أقسموا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسموا﴾; ﴿جهد﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "they swore by Allah striving hard in their oaths", or standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the meaning of the maṣdar, the sense being "they swore an oath of utmost effort in swearing". ﴿أيمانهم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لئن﴾: the lām is preparing for an oath (mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿جاءهم﴾: a past verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is the sign of the plural; ﴿نذير﴾: fāʿil; ﴿ليكونن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and ﴿يكونن﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which is omitted because of the succession of like letters; the wāw of the plural, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the noun of yakūnu, and the doubled nūn is for emphasis; ﴿أهدى﴾: the khabar (predicate) of yakūnu; ﴿من إحدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أهدى﴾; ﴿الأمم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿وأقسموا بالله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿فلما جاءهم نذير ما زادهم إلا نفورا﴾: الفاء: conjunctive; ﴿لما﴾: a temporal adverb meaning "when" (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking particle containing the sense of a condition; ﴿جاءهم﴾: a past verb, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; ﴿نذير﴾: fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾: negating; ﴿زادهم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "هو", the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; ﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); ﴿نفورًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ما زادهم...﴾ is the answer to ﴿لَمّا﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿استكبارا في الأرض ومكر السيئ﴾: استكبارًا: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of arrogance", or badal (substitute) from ﴿نفورًا﴾, or ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in the state of being arrogant". في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استكبارًا﴾; مكرَ السيئ: conjoined to ﴿استكبارًا﴾ or to ﴿نفورًا﴾; السيئ: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and this is an annexation of the qualified noun to its adjective, or the qualified noun is omitted, i.e. "the plotting of the evil deed".
﴿ولا يحيق المكر السيئ إلا بأهله﴾: الواو: circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لا: negating; يحيق: an imperfect verb; المكر: fāʿil (agent); السيئ: naʿt (adjective); إلا: a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); بأهله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحيق﴾; the clause ﴿ولا يحيق...﴾ is circumstantial.
﴿فهل ينظرون إلا سنت الأولين﴾: الفاء: conjunctive; هل: an interrogative particle; ينظرون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; إلا: a particle of restriction; سنة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأولين: muḍāf ilayhi; the interrogative clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿فلما جاءهم نذير...﴾.
﴿فلن تجد لسنت الله تبديلا﴾: الفاء: of faṣīḥa, i.e. "whatever may be, you will not find any change in the way of Allah"; لن: a particle of negation, of the subjunctive and of the future; تجد: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan; لسنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبديلا﴾, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; تبديلا: the object of تجد.
﴿ولن تجد لسنت الله تحويلا﴾: لن: a particle of negation, of the subjunctive and of the future; تجد: an imperfect verb, accusative by lan; لسنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحويلا﴾, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; تحويلا: the object of تجد; the clause ﴿لن تجد لسنة الله تحويلا﴾ is conjoined to the one before it, ﴿لن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا﴾.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿أولم يسيروا في الأرض﴾: the hamza: for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); الواو: conjoining to something implied that the context calls for, i.e. "did they keep to their dwellings and not travel?"; لم: a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; يسيروا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); في الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسيروا﴾.
﴿فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم﴾: الفاء: conjunctive, and the clause ﴿ينظروا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يسيروا﴾; كيف: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb; عاقبة: the delayed noun of kāna; الذين: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من قبلهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿كيف كان عاقبة...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of ينظروا.
﴿وكانوا أشد منهم قوة﴾: الواو: circumstantial; كانوا: the defective ﴿كان﴾, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; أشد: the khabar of kāna; منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشد﴾; قوة: tamyīz (specification); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما كان الله ليعجزه من شيء في السماوات ولا في الأرض﴾: الواو: conjunctive or circumstantial; ما: negating; كان: a defective verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no wāw of the plural here, and the noun of ﴿كان﴾ is evidently the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾.]; ﴿ليعجزه﴾: ﴿اللام﴾ is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and ﴿يعجزه﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of denial, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive is attached to an omitted khabar of kāna; مِن: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); شيء: fāʿil, nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿من﴾; في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شيء﴾; ولا في الأرض: conjoined to ﴿في السماوات﴾.
﴿إنه كان عليما قديرا﴾: إنه: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the hāʾ is its noun; كان: a defective verb, the noun of kāna latent (mustatir), implied as "هو"; عليمًا: the khabar of kāna; قديرًا: a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; the clause ﴿كان عليما قديرا﴾ is the khabar of inna, and the clause ﴿إنه كان عليما قديرا﴾ gives the reason for the denial that anything can frustrate Him.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بما كسبوا ما ترك على ظهرها من دابة﴾: الواو: resumptive; لو: conditional; يؤاخذ: an imperfect verb; الله: fāʿil (agent); الناس: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بما: the bāʾ is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive, i.e. "for that which they earned", or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, i.e. "for their earning"; the bāʾ with its genitive is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤاخذ﴾; كسبوا: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كسبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ما ترك﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ما: negating; ترك: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "هو"; على ظهرها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترك﴾, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من: a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr ṣila); دابة: genitive in form, accusative in position as the object of ترك; the clause ﴿ولو يؤاخذ الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن يؤخرهم إلى أجل مسمى﴾: الواو: conjunctive; لكن: lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala), for rectification (istidrāk); يؤخرهم: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "هو", the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the plural; إلى أجل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤخرهم﴾; مسمى: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجل﴾; the clause ﴿ولكن يؤخرهم...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ولو يؤاخذ...﴾.
﴿فإذا جاء أجلهم فإن الله كان بعباده بصيرا﴾: الفاء: conjunctive; إذا: an adverb of the future containing the sense of a condition; جاء: a past verb; أجلهم: fāʿil, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿جاء أجلهم﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb being annexed to it; the apodosis (jawāb) of إذا is omitted, its implied form being "يجازيهم بما كسبوا" (He will recompense them for what they earned), and the conditional sentence is conjoined to the clause ﴿يؤخرهم﴾. ﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the noun of kāna latent, implied as "هو", referring to Allah the Exalted; بعباده: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بصيرًا﴾; بصيرًا: the khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause ﴿كان بعباده بصيرا﴾ is the khabar of inna, and the clause ﴿إن الله كان بعباده بصيرا﴾ gives the reason for the implied apodosis.
